title: No Gelation and Global Existence for a Boltzmann Equation with Regularly Varying Mass-Exchange Rates
summary: We develop a no-gelation mechanism that yields global solutions to the spatially homogeneous Boltzmann equation with mass exchange for Grad-cutoff hard potentials $B=E^γb(ξ), 0<γ<1$ and regularly varying mass-exchange rates. Without assuming any higher mass moment, we construct a convex superlinear weight assembled from dyadic hinges. Production of the weighted moment by collisions between large particles of comparable mass is absorbed by dissipation through collisions with a uniformly populated reservoir of bounded-mass particles.
